Hello, we reviewed this issue and determined that it doesn't fall into the bug report or feature request category. This issue tracker is not suitable for support requests, please repost your issue on [StackOverflow](http://stackoverflow.com/) using tag `angular`.

If you are wondering why we don't resolve support issues via the issue tracker, please [check out this explanation](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#-got-a-question-or-problem).
Actually I think that it is, since the meta service is from angular, why do you think that it's not an actual bug report for us @Toxicable ?

>Now if I go to route /, i only see the meta tags for that page, but if i go to any other route, I see the meta tags for route / followed by css styles, followed by meta tags for the page I am currently on.

This indicates that the issue is caused by how the Meta service is being used rather than a bug with the service itself. If there is a bug the Meta service then to verify it a plunkr/Stack Blitz would be needed.
Hard to do a plunkr for an universal app unfortunately :(

>This is on server side and client side both.

I assume that's meaning independently.

Side note: Stack Blitz is actually working on supporting Node apps at sometime Q1 next year
This can be related to #19093 try to remove `BrowserAnimationsModule`
@Agrumas I think that is unlikely. The Meta service is almost directly editing the head tags' DOM, it's never interacting with views, which is where your issue linked resides

@Toxicable I have followed online examples for meta service and the code is straightforward enough to not cause this issue. I even tried remove tag and force creation to get rid of the twice occurring meta tags but it didn't work. I've never used plunkr or stackblitz but will try to give it a shot. As I said, you can work the issue at www.thepixelatedplanet.com and I can provide cover from there.

Seeing the result, the linked website, is not reasonable enough for us to action this issue.
We cannot see the source code, we cannot identify if it's a problem with your app or with Angular itself.
This is why we require a plunkr ot Stack Blitz, there is just too many moving parts in a full application.
@Toxicable those platforms don't support universal. I checked and this only shows for server rendered html. I can give you the simplest repro in a github.com repo hosted somewhere if that works?

@Toxicable @ocombe @Agrumas  I have a super simple universal app with this repro now -
Code --> https://github.com/shreyagarwaldev/MetaBugDemo
Demo --> https://piplanet-shrey.herokuapp.com/ 
There are 2 pages, super empty. Just try viewing source for each. One of them will repeat the meta tags. I only have 2 meta tags (og:title, twitter:title). And when it repeats, the first value is from the other page.

This is an issues with server side rendering. I am not necessarily sure how else I can convince you guys that there is an issue here :) I hoped it was something in my app, but it seems to be a legit bug.
